products.description: Nina Footwear is one of the few family-run fashion companies in the shoe business. In the early 1950s, Mike and Stanley Silverstein were strolling around New York when they saw a woman walk by in wood bottom sandals. They asked her about where she had bought them, and when she named a chic boutique in the city, the two brothers knew the time was right to launch their reinterpretation of the clog -- a sexy, platform slide with a wood stiletto-like heel. It was this simple slide that launched Nina Footwear. Today, Nina's sexy, well-priced shoes are widely featured in fashion magazines. A favorite of the "splurge vs. steal" columns, Nina is frequently shown as the only fashion item under $100 along side of shoes priced from $300-$700.

products.title: Lauren by Ralph Lauren Women's Pearle Platform
products.description: Faux-straw, durable canvas, and a crochet toe cap lend warm-weather style to the Pearle espadrille, which is designed with a chic wedge silhouette.

products.title: Stride Rite Little and Big Girls Jillian Mary Jane Shoe
products.description: Stride Rite's Jillian mary jane shoes for little girls brings an updated classic to her busy, little feet. Featuring exposed stitching on the smooth leather uppers, a simple and secure velcro strap closure across the vamps and a chicly-styled molded rubber out-sole, these mary janes will keep her feet looking as good as they feel. Stride Rite designs and engineers footwear specifically to meet the needs of growing children. Stride Rite's mission is to encourage kids and support parents by developing and marketing products that help children embrace life's possibilities and adventures with confidence. Stride Rite shoes aren't like any other shoes you'll buy. They're better. With more than 85 years of experience, they've learned a few things about their craft. Stride Rite is the one company that's been helping kids run, jump, leap, grow, and playfully express themselves since 1919.

products.title: Sam Edelman Women's Leya Fashion Sneaker
products.description: Suede fashion sneaker with faux fur pom pom detail Sam Edelman shoes epitomize chic comfort. With exceptional materials and fine styling, each pair of Sam Edelman shoes is an affordable luxury that cleverly combines a youthful outlook with a worldly sensibility. Sophistication with down-to-earth appeal mean that these shoes are made to be lived in. Whether it's a classic revisited for a modern interpretation or a cutting edge design, Sam Edelman shoes always keep an emphasis on comfort.

products.description: A classic wardrobe staple. Timeless elegance defines this women's pump with an iconic silhouette, scooped vamp, and wear-all-day heel. Get there beautifully. Sleek, all-day pump with walkable heel. Leather, patent leather, suede or fabric upper with closed round toe. Contour+ Comfort technology for a premium fit and all-day comfort experience. Available in an inclusive size range of tough-to-find sizes and widths for a custom-designed fit and feel for all-day wear. The Shoe With the Beautiful Fit. Since 1927. Naturalizer's fresh, unpretentious designs are a smooth fit with your wardrobe, your life and your own unique style. Naturalizer promises style that makes you look good and feel good - always.

products.title: Steve Madden Women's Gills Fashion Sneaker
products.description: We’ve elevated our classic slip-on sneaker this season, adding a platform sole and luxurious suede surfaces for a look that’s chicly refined. What began as a modest $1100 investment in 1990 has developed into one of the most iconic brands in footwear. From a factory in Queens, NY, Steve Madden has revolutionized the shoe industry, merging years of experience with unique and creative designs. Inspired by rock and roll and his New York roots, his vision to provide on-trend women and men with an outlet to express their individuality is innovative, daring, and inspiring. Steve’s innate understanding of trends and unparalleled willpower have resulted in millions of customers worldwide and propelled his designs to the forefront of fashion. He has expanded the Steve Madden brand into a true lifestyle and destination for footwear, handbags and accessories, sold in over 80 countries worldwide. It’s about authenticity. It’s about embracing individuality. It’s Steve Madden.

dialogue.user: Those are some great options! I notice that the average rating on all of them is 4.6 or 4.5. I'm looking for shoes with at least a 5.0 rating. Do you have any shoes that meet that criteria?
dialogue.agent: I'm sorry, but we don't have any shoes in your price range with a 5.0 rating. Would you like to see the highest-rated shoes we do have, or is there anything else I can assist you with?

dialogue.user: I see. Well, since I can't find anything with a 5.0 rating, I'll have to consider the next best options. Could you tell me more about the **Sam Edelman Women's Leya Fashion Sneaker**? It seems to have a lot of reviews, which is important to me. What do the reviews say about it?
dialogue.agent:
The **Sam Edelman Women's Leya Fashion Sneaker** is priced at $78.98, has an average rating of 4.5 stars from 42 reviews, and is ranked #104 in its category. Here are some of its features:

- 100% Leather
- Rubber sole
- Suede flatform sneaker with large faux-fur pom poms at vamp
- Seamless padded collar
- Concealed elastic insert under tongue

**Description:** Suede fashion sneaker with faux fur pom pom detail. Sam Edelman shoes epitomize chic comfort with exceptional materials and fine styling, offering an affordable luxury that combines a youthful outlook with a worldly sensibility. These shoes are made to be lived in, emphasizing comfort whether it's a classic design or a cutting-edge one.

**Top Reviews:**

1. **Rating: 5.0 - "I call them Tribble Tennies"**
   - "Awesome, comfy, fun. Friends thought the fluffy balls looked like baby Tribbles. On a chilly day with a big sweater and jeans, slip these on and make yourself smile. Good quality. I go between 8.5-9 and sized down to 8.5. Sort of snug, but cushy insole and style make that work fine."

2. **Rating: 4.0 - "These are so cute but SO HUGE."**
   - "These are so cute but SO HUGE. I'm in between an 8 and 8.5 normally and my heel was coming out of the 8. If in doubt at all between 2 sizes, ORDER DOWN."

3. **Rating: 5.0 - "Love these shoes!"**
   - "These shoes are so flippin' cute! Do not let the negative reviews discourage you from buying these. They are not cheaply made nor do they look it. I bought the grey suede and they are gorgeous with all pom poms in tact. I would caution going down a half size though."

Would you like more information or assistance with anything else?

top_reviews.title: I call them Tribble Tennies
top_reviews.text:
Awesome, comfy, fun. (Always my buzzwords for shoe collecting). Friends thought the fluffy balls looked like baby Tribbles (Google original "Star Trek" series haha)
On a chilly day with a big sweater and jeans, slip these on and make yourself smile. Good quality. I go between 8.5-9 and sized down to 8.5. Sort of snug, but cushy insole and style make that work fine. Didn't want them too big and falling off (sole is thick and heavier)

top_reviews.title: These are so cute but SO HUGE. I'm in ...
top_reviews.text: These are so cute but SO HUGE. I'm in between an 8 and 8.5 normally and my heel was coming out of the 8. So much so that I'm not even sure if the 7.5 will be small enough! If in doubt at all between 2 sizes, ORDER DOWN.

top_reviews.title: Love these shoes!
top_reviews.text: These shoes are so flippin' cute! Do not let the negative reviews discourage you from buying these.  They are not cheaply made nor do they look it. I bought the grey suede and they are gorgeous with all pom poms in tact.  Hopefully they will stay that way and if not I will take them to a shoe repair shop - I love them that much.  I would caution going down a half size though. I always wear a size 9 in any shoe and these do slip in the back of the heel.  I debated sending them back for an 8.5 but I did not want to hassle with it and I can still wear them as is.  I'm wearing them now with skinny jeans and a Tshirt!

dialogue.user: The **Sam Edelman Women's Leya Fashion Sneaker** sounds really cute and comfortable! I like that it has a lot of reviews, and the top reviews seem positive overall. It's also within my budget. I think I might go with these. <YES>
